config.pageTitle: Marcelo G. Racca — Audio Director & Sound Designer
config.name: Marcelo G. Racca
config.tagline: Audio Director • Sound Designer • Audio Postproduction
config.aboutText:
Hi, I’m Marcelo Racca. For over 18 years, I’ve been crafting sonic worlds at the intersection of storytelling and audio engineering. 
Whether shaping audio for global brands, immersive interactive experiences, or intimate independent films, I approach every project with the same belief: sound should serve the story with both technical precision and emotional honesty. 
I’m endlessly curious about how audio can deepen human connection across mediums, and I bring that passion to everything I create and explore.
